scope: single mobile SVG legibility fix; lesson, course, registry, math, state, and interactions untouched
issue_fixed: At a 360px viewport, SVG viewBox scaling reduced the smallest chart labels below the required 11px effective size.
fixes_applied: Raised the upper SVGs' mobile-only 10-11 unit labels to 11.25 units while restoring their original 10, 10.5, and 11 unit sizes at the sm breakpoint.
Raised the waveform title, ticks, and axis title to 14.5 units on mobile while restoring their original 12, 10, and 10.5 unit desktop sizes at sm.
Split the phasor's I/Q role names and six-decimal values into non-overlapping mobile-only rows; the original desktop label group remains active at sm and above.
Moved the enlarged mobile waveform axis title four user units upward so its glyph box clears the SVG boundary.

mobile_inspection.tooling: Actual component server-rendered with compiled app/globals.css via PostCSS/Tailwind, then measured and screenshot with headless Chrome.
mobile_inspection.result: PASS: every title, role label, numeric label, tick, and axis label is legible; I/Q names and values do not collide; sample stems remain discrete; both themes retain all outlines, dashed cues, and semantic colors.
